permit.applies: The employer or 'sponsor' applies on the employee's behalf to the Immigration Department (form C-3, with a detailed cover letter), and the worker must be registered before starting work; all fees are paid on submission.
permit.first: A detailed cover letter from the potential employer (for a long-term permit, proof that no resident or Barbadian national is capable and willing to fill the post).

fees.what: Application fee (the final fee varies with the category of work and the length requested)

sources.title: Barbados Immigration Department, Work Permits: Section 17 of the Immigration Act, Cap. 190
sources.said: All non-nationals desirous of working in Barbados are required to register with immigration prior to commencing employment. … Short-Term work permits are valid for a period up to eleven months. The employer or 'sponsor' has the responsibility to make the application on behalf of the employee. Requirements for short-term work permits A detailed cover letter from the potential employer C-3 Application form … prospective employers must sufficiently prove that no resident or Barbadian national is capable and willing to fulfill the requirements of the position in question. … THE APPLICATION FEE IS $300.00 BDS BUT THE FINAL FEE WILL VARY DEPENDENT ON THE CATEGORY OF WORK AND THE LENGTH OF TIME REQUESTED … Application for Work Permit of Extension of a Work Permit … All fees must be paid on submission of applications.
